up: Retrieve the distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and preferred names of all molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4296182'. Do not apply any additional filters on assay type, confidence score, or activity values.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296182'
